source.name: Sunderland AFC – 'Sunderland AFC and Shuffle join forces in new global sleeve partnership'
source.quote: Sunderland AFC is delighted to announce Shuffle as the Club’s new Official Sleeve Partner in a multi-year partnership.

source.name: Sunderland AFC – 'Sunderland 2026-27 home shirt on sale now!'
source.quote: with red hummel chevrons proudly sitting on the shoulders

summary: Sunderland start 2026-27 with a blank front: the Premier League's new ban on front-of-shirt gambling sponsors ended W88's deal, and a proposed Visit Ghana deal collapsed in September 2026. Shuffle is the sleeve sponsor and hummel makes the kit. Every placement checked: nothing on the front, Shuffle on the sleeve.

change.text: Worse than last season: W88 left the front and no replacement was signed before the season began
